# Left and Right Sum Differences.

@example Pile 1 has 2 coins to its left and 1 + 5 = 6 to its right, a gap of 4.
[2,7,1,5]
=> [13,4,4,10]

@example The middle pile has 7 coins on each side, so its gap is 0.
[5,2,9,2,5]
=> [18,11,0,11,18]

@example Pile 0 has nothing to its left and 1 coin to its right.
[40,1]
=> [1,40]

# A single pile: both sides are empty.
[6]
=> [0]

[100000]
=> [0]

# Two equal piles.
[3,3]
=> [3,3]

# All piles the same.
[4,4,4,4,4]
=> [16,8,0,8,16]

# Distinct sizes, so counting pile i on a side changes the answer; the
# right side is heavier at first, the left side later.
[1,2,3,4,5,6]
=> [20,17,12,5,4,15]

# A balance point away from the middle.
[6,1,2,3,9]
=> [15,8,5,0,12]

# Sizes going down.
[9,7,5,3,1]
=> [16,0,12,20,24]

# The largest pile size.
[100000,100000,100000]
=> [200000,0,200000]

[1,100000,1]
=> [100001,0,100001]
